cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: v4 (Brooks 9/1): one sentence of agitation added after the Birkin hook, and the pivot keyed to the SHAPE so it never reads as 'here is a Birkin'. Reference (IG reel Dcl0MfxMwts) donates its LOOK only: creator on a navy couch behind a podcast mic, split hook over Birkin street footage, Didot cards, one serif phrase per cutaway. 122 words, 33.15s, name at 0:10.9, unbroken PDP close. APPROVE: (1) creator keyframe (C blue shirt on the board; A/B knit in the moodboard), (2) the bed. HeyGen render is gated on this board.

NOTES

cards.title: v4: AGITATION BEAT ADDED, PIVOT RE-KEYED
cards.text: Brooks 9/1: 'But I have the perfect one for you' straight after the hook framed it as a Birkin. Now: hook → one sentence of agitation (access, then price-for-name) → 'if it's the shape you love, I found the perfect one' → 'This is the Vivienne from Velantra' at 0:10.9. Intro lands past the 0:06 law because the agitation sentence was asked for.

cards.title: APPROVAL GATE
cards.text: Pick the creator keyframe (C blue shirt on the board, A/B cream knit in the moodboard) and approve the bed. HeyGen Avatar V render fires only after this (~235 credits for 33s).

cards.title: Birkin boundaries
cards.text: Birkin lives in VO and captions only, never in a generation prompt. No Hermès price, no dupe/replica wording, no scam register, she is not framed as priced out. Hermès the house is unnamed unless Brooks says otherwise.

cards.title: Hook footage is sourced
cards.text: Editor sources two short street clips of a Birkin being carried for the split hook. The frames on the board are the reference's own, placeholders only, never ship.

cards.title: VO already read
cards.text: Woman Over 40, eleven_v3, 33.15s after dead-space removal, no atempo. 122 words, Scribe gate passed, no pauses around Birkin / Vivienne / Velantra.

cards.title: Overlays
cards.text: Didot, white, soft shadow. Cards across the chest, never the face. One phrase caption per shot, not word-synced, like the reference.
